svg.title: Heat treatment cycle spindle shaft (example)
svg.text: Heat treatment of the spindle shaft 31CrMoV9 – QT (steel mill) → stress relief (Op 50) → gas nitriding (Op 90) → hardness profile
Temperature–time curves (example values – the heat treater's program wins) and hardness vs depth with the nitriding hardness depth NHD
(a) QT of the bar – steel mill
purge N₂, heat 5 h; cool under N₂
0.03 mm per side ground off (Op 100) → NHD left ≥ 0.47 (drawing ≥ 0.4)
case hardened (dashed): ≈ 720 HV, needs 0.2 mm/side stock
Tempering parameter P = T_K · (20 + log t):
nitriding 520 °C 44 h = 17 166 → both below 18 129: core stays
Case depth (Harris) d ≈ 0.65 · √t mm at 930 °C → CHD 1.0: ≈ 7 h
Coupon per charge: ≥ 750 HV1 · NHD ≥ 0.43 · white layer ≤ 10–12 µm
Distortion after nitriding ≤ 15 µm runout (V-blocks, bearing seats)
Growth on Ø ≈ +6 µm → pre-grind stock 0.06 mm on Ø is enough
Lehrer diagram: high K_N = ε compound layer, low K_N = γ′ / none
Hang vertically · clean oxide-free surface · mask threads (paste)
Values = twin example values · not to scale · 2026-11
